create_soft_update_optimizer: create a SoftUpdate optimizer to blend source params into target params with a tau factor
run_soft_update_step: run a single soft update step on target network parameters using the SoftUpdate optimizer
build_optimizer_scheduler: build an optimizer scheduler dict using SoftUpdate.make_optimizer_scheduler with target and source params
review_soft_update_init: review the SoftUpdate constructor to validate target and source param shapes and tau range
test_soft_update_closure: test the SoftUpdate step method with an optional closure that reevaluates the model and returns loss
